title: Closure under shifted disjunction
statement: For every Boolean predicate $M$ and natural numbers $a,k,a',k'$, if the verifier associated to $M$ is efficient in the model, then the predicate on three bit strings that returns true when, for some $i<a'(|x|+1)^{k'}$, applying $M$ to $x$ and the coordinatewise exclusive-or of $v$ with the block of $u$ beginning at position $i\,a(|x|+1)^k$ and having length $a(|x|+1)^k$ returns true is an efficient two-witness predicate in the model. The exclusive-or is taken pairwise over the two lists up to the length of the shorter list.
hypotheses_covered: The verifier associated to $M$ is efficient
